explicit_validation.explanation: Both LLM and human evaluations are conducted but they are performed independently on different samples (LLM on comparative dataset evaluations and human on model performance/dataset quality) with no quantitative comparison or correlation analysis reported between the two methods

prompts.notes: Appendix includes detailed prompts for evaluation, including metrics and instructions shown in Table 22 (automated evaluator guidelines)

inter_annotator_agreement.interpretation: Evaluators work in groups of three per conversation to measure inter-annotator agreement

guidelines.notes: Appendix E provides detailed evaluation guidelines including metric descriptions and scoring criteria (5-point scale) for dataset quality and model performance

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM and human evaluate different sets of instances with different primary objectives - LLM used for comparative dataset evaluations while human evaluation focuses on model performance and dataset quality assessment
